entry.label: Thinking in Systems
entry.description: Donella Meadows's concise introduction to stocks, flows, feedback, delays, resilience, self-organisation and the practical discipline of seeing systems without assuming prediction and control.
entry.canonical_definition: Donella Meadows's concise introduction to stocks, flows, feedback, delays, resilience, self-organisation and the practical discipline of seeing systems without assuming prediction and control.

profile.title: Thinking in Systems
profile.canonical_definition: Donella Meadows's concise introduction to stocks, flows, feedback, delays, resilience, self-organisation and the practical discipline of seeing systems without assuming prediction and control.
profile.summary: Thinking in Systems introduces system structures and behaviours through ordinary examples while retaining the discipline of stocks, flows, feedback, delays and resilience.
profile.why_it_matters: It is a widely used route into systems thinking that combines technical clarity with cautions about boundaries, values, surprise and control.
common_misreadings: all systems can be reduced to one diagram
the text offers prediction rather than disciplined inquiry
profile.editorial_note: Developed from public primary, institutional and publisher sources. Open to correction, rival interpretation and stronger evidence.
